settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Choose the language used across the dashboard.

exchangeRates.title: Exchange rates
exchangeRates.help: Controls the USD to RWF rate used across the platform. Listing prices stay in the currency their seller chose; this rate only drives the approximate conversion shown alongside them.
exchangeRates.fallbackHelp: Used whenever the live provider is unavailable. This is what users see during an outage, so keep it current.
exchangeRates.overrideHelp: Pins the rate and ignores the live provider entirely.
exchangeRates.overrideRateRequired: Enter a rate, or turn the override off.
exchangeRates.loadFailed: Could not load exchange rate settings
exchangeRates.wiseNotConfiguredHelp: WISE_API_TOKEN is not set on the server, so the fallback rate below is being used. Setting it requires a deploy — API credentials are deliberately not editable here.
exchangeRates.noRateHelp: RWF prices cannot be shown until a fallback rate is set below, or live rates are configured. Nothing is guessed in the meantime.
